nodes.healthy_interpretation: The selected authorized recovery completes and the affected service/lane or AGV/tote state is corrected without introducing additional discrepancies.
nodes.unhealthy_interpretation: Recovery cannot be completed or the abnormal state persists; recovery introduces additional tote/AGV discrepancies.
nodes.inconclusive_interpretation: The incident packet does not identify exact service names, authorization boundaries, or safe physical conditions needed for recovery.

optional_corroboration.note: After recovery, proceed to node_5 validation; do not self-declare success without confirming hospital tote-flow and sustained sort operation.

nodes.intent: Confirm that recovery restored the affected workflow without leaving residual AGV, tote, or station-state anomalies.
nodes.goal: Confirm that recovery restored the affected workflow without leaving residual AGV, tote, or station-state anomalies.
nodes.runbook_placeholder: Procedure needed to validate Hospital Lane and hospital HMI tote-add and tote-remove behavior, confirm AGV roster and location state through the source-used fleet or Aveva/API view, confirm relevant service responsiveness when applicable, and monitor sort long enough to distinguish stable recovery from a temporary movement indication.
nodes.source_supported_description: The source reports that totes could again be added and removed, robots were re-added and running, movement started, and the system was running by the later recovery updates.
nodes.needed_runbook_capability: Procedure needed to validate Hospital Lane and hospital HMI tote-add and tote-remove behavior, confirm AGV roster and location state through the source-used fleet or Aveva/API view, confirm relevant service responsiveness when applicable, and monitor sort long enough to distinguish stable recovery from a temporary movement indication.
nodes.expected_or_observed_result: Site operator observes tote handling and sort operation, while authorized support checks the relevant service or API/Aveva status used during recovery. Healthy signal: totes can be added and removed, Hospital Lane accepts normal flow, AGVs are re-added or operating in expected locations, movement resumes, and sort starts and remains stable. Unhealthy signal: tote addition remains blocked, AGVs remain stopped or misplaced, disconnected tote state persists, or sort fails again. Inconclusive: only a general statement that the system is running is available without confirmation of hospital tote flow and residual AGV/tote state.

source_used_surfaces.source_evidence: The source includes HMI-style hospital/rack views and reports validation in terms of adding and removing totes.
Chat states that Aveva was used for AGV and tote state correction.
Source validation statements report that the site was running, totes could be added and removed, and robots were re-added and running.

ontology_capabilities.relevant_evidence: The incident includes location and rack anomalies, so pairing or location consistency may be relevant to validation, but the source does not confirm a pairing fault.

ontology_gaps: No supplied ontology mapping defines the exact validation fields for hospital tote induction, residual tote association, or the source's API dog/Aveva actions.
healthy_indicators: Site confirms totes can again be added and removed.
Hospital Lane accepts normal tote flow.
AGVs are re-added and operating in expected locations.
Movement resumes and sort remains running.
No disconnected or residual tote association is reported.
unhealthy_indicators: Hospital tote addition remains unavailable.
AGVs remain stopped, misplaced, duplicated under a rack, or absent from expected locations.
A disconnected tote remains associated in the system.
Sort cannot start or stops again during monitoring.
inconclusive_indicators: Only the statement "system is running" is available.
Validation covers movement but not hospital tote-add behavior.
The HMI or API/Aveva view is unreadable or unavailable.
No stable observation period is available.

AGVs are re-added/operating and appear in expected locations (no persistent duplicate/missing occupancy)
